page.overview:
Who is Armenauth?

Armenauth was a male pilot who served as a squadron leader of Squadron Four and held the military rank of captain within the 204th Imperial Fighter Wing, which was part of the loyalist forces of the Galactic Empire. He was given leadership of Squadron Four after Jothal Gablerone's death during the Attack on Cerberon.
